importantFindings.title: Single deletes of a person's data still depend on device clocks (accepted)
importantFindings.evidence: Unchanged at 822cb50. The whole-course erase is unconditional. A single-row delete still follows the B4 rule, as decisions 16 and 19 record until 1.0.0.

importantFindings.title: The server tombstone still waits for the owner's migration (B6-ERASE-RULES)
importantFindings.evidence: The live run skipped the CVERA branch again because erased_courses is not installed. The fix keeps such ids locally with erase = 2 and repeats the delete at each connection until the server can record them (session.ts settleServerErasures, serverErasures.ts markDeletedOnServer). Until the migration runs, another phone's late upsert of the course row can recreate the course. Each later connection of the erasing phone then deletes it again; the phone where it was erased does not download it back, because it deletes before it connects. A signed-out full reset in that window drops the erase = 2 record, so that id never gets a tombstone.
importantFindings.reproduction: tests/e2e/b6-erase-live.spec.ts: 3 passed, CVERA branch not run.

qolFindings.title: Under another account, the erase confirmation's 'questo account' is ambiguous
qolFindings.evidence: CourseErase.tsx: signedIn leaves out 'other-account', so the text reads 'quando rientri con questo account da questo telefono' while a different account is signed in. The erase completes only under the device's own account.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading of CourseErase.tsx signedIn and the conditional text.

qolFindings.title: An empty synced device runs VACUUM at every open
qolFindings.evidence: migrations.ts prepareDatabase calls compactEmptyCourseDatabase whenever courseLeftThisDevice is true, which includes a device that is simply empty or restoring, not only one whose course just left. That is cheap on an empty database, but it runs inside the measured startup path.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading of migrations.ts courseLeftThisDevice and its call in prepareDatabase.
